summary: Frontend-only PWA testing of 'Gym with Lalu' Phase 1. All 14 requested flows verified working: PWA manifest + SW served at /manifest.json and /service-worker.js (200 OK), ProfileSelect renders Add/Guest buttons, guest bypasses PIN → /dashboard, Add Profile (name → 4-digit PIN) creates profile and lands on dashboard, returning shows profile tile → PIN pad gate, wrong PIN shows error+shake, correct PIN (1234) opens dashboard, dashboard shows exactly 7 day tiles with default 'Pending' status and '0 of 6 days done' header, Day 2 (Chest) has 8 cards including 1 B-circuit with 6 mini-exercises (Step Jumping Jacks, Plate Swings, Plate Ground-to-Overhead, Bent-Over Plate Rows, Small Jumps, High Knees), Day 6 (Biceps) has 8 cards including 1 B-circuit with 6 mini-exercises (Basic Step-Ups, Fast Step-Ups, Lateral Step-Over with Floor Touch, Step Straddle Jumps, Quick Toe Taps, Box Jumps), marking Done increments counter to '1 of 6 days done', logout returns to ProfileSelect. SW registration script present in index.html.
critical_code_review_comments: Storage 'gym_lalu_v1' uses plain-text PIN — acceptable per chosen scope (plain PIN), but flag for any future privacy hardening.

Auto-Monday reset relies on mondayKey() recomputed per render via useMemo with empty deps; for a session that crosses midnight Monday the dashboard won't auto-roll until reload. Acceptable for PWA usage but worth noting.
DayDetail navigates immediately on mark, no toast confirmation — minor UX nit, not a bug.
test_credentials: Created TEST profile 'Lalu' with PIN 1234 in localStorage (per spec)
seed_data_creation: Created one profile 'Lalu' / PIN 1234 during automation; resides only in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA frontend-only, no backend. Base URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Mobile viewport 412x900. Note DAY_META.title is mixed-case ('Chest','Biceps','Rest') with CSS class 'uppercase'; assert via case-insensitive checks if needed. data-testid coverage is complete on all interactive elements.
